description:
From: Optimize. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 (reworked page https://claude.ai/artifact/8W4224acER7sMprXf72Bba, "approved", relayed by Optimize). Supersedes the earlier "term-carrying exception from an fz-ABI extern" plan.

Today: map externs return `:: any`, so a proven map loses its proof at every extern return. CLIF shows a proven map's put has no kind test, while a put loop has 8. The runtime checks "expected a map" and panics (e.g. Map.put(1, :a, 2): runtime/src/heap/map_view.rs:70) where Elixir raises BadMapError.

Change:
- :maps and Map specs say `map` where they take or return one.
- The map externs (fz_map_put, delete, has_key, count, keys, values, the walk, from_kv's result) declare `map`.
- The runtime's "expected a map" checks become debug_assert!.
- Map.delete and Map.get/2 get the is_map guard that raises BadMapError.

fz-sc8.122 closes with this ticket: its survey is done; 17 of 20 Map functions already raise correctly and the 3 aborts are fixed here.

Done when: Map.put/delete/get on a non-map raise BadMapError in Elixir's shape on interp, run and build (fixture); the put loop's kind tests fall; no pin rises.

Folded in (user chose "Fold into fz-mue.59", then approved the design with "proceed", relayed by Optimize 2026-11-24; page section "Folded in: is_map on an unknown value" at https://claude.ai/artifact/8W4224acER7sMprXf72Bba):
- A NAMED bit (struct header bit 5, agreed with GC) makes "any named struct" one test.
- Type tests read the kind once, test kind-only axes first with a kind-set mask, and admit early.
- is_binary/is_bitstring are covered too, at Binary Handling's request.
Evidence for the fold: is_map lowers to struct OR maps axes, each extracting the kind separately; in a put loop over an unknown value CLIF goes from 5 to 13 ushr 56. Still one commit.
title: Map externs declare their types and trust them; specs keep the proof
